question: What alternative breadth measurements are allowed relative to the nose width?
premises: The nose width serves as the basis.
Two daṇḍas is one permitted measure.
Three daṇḍas is an alternative measure.
inference: Relative to the nose width, the measure may be two daṇḍas or three daṇḍas.
uncertainties: Whether this applies to projection or another dimension is context-dependent.
plain_english: From the width of the nose, the measure may be two daṇḍas or three daṇḍas.
